$comment: Exposure-based advisory backlog (audit D-05). Every entry was reviewed as NOT reachable from the deployed runtime and NOT safely upgradeable; scripts/sca-check.mjs fails CI on any advisory not listed here, so a new advisory - or one on a runtime package - must be fixed or reviewed before it can merge. The 2026-09-26 pass upgraded the other 28 packages away (react-form 1.x, turbo 2.11, vitest 4, webpack 5.111, tailwind 3.4.19, overrides in package.json).

esbuild.reason: Only convex/esbuild@0.23.0 is affected: convex 1.19.2 pins it EXACTLY, and convex is itself pinned to 1.19.2 to match the self-hosted backend (CLAUDE.md), so it cannot move without a backend upgrade. The advisory is the esbuild DEV SERVER (serve/context) answering cross-origin requests; the Convex CLI calls only esbuild.build (dist/cjs/bundler), never serve or context, and bundles repository source at deploy time. Every other esbuild in the tree is >=0.25.0.
